items.source:
ReactiveInsertOperation allows creation and execution of reactive MongoDB insert and bulk insert operations in a fluent API style.
The collection to operate on is by default derived from the initial domainType and can be defined there via Document. Using inCollection allows to override the collection name for the execution. 
    
        insert(Jedi.class)
            .inCollection("star-wars")
            .one(luke);
items.translation:
ReactiveInsertOperation 允许以流畅的 API 风格创建并执行反应式的 MongoDB 插入和批量插入操作。默认情况下，要操作的集合是从初始的 domainType 派生的，并且可以通过 Document 在此处定义。使用 inCollection 可以覆盖执行时的集合名称。 
    
        insert(Jedi.class)
            .inCollection("star-wars")
            .one(luke);

items.source: Compose insert execution by calling one of the terminating methods.
items.translation: 通过调用终止方法之一来执行插入。

items.source: new instance of ReactiveInsertOperation.ReactiveInsert. Never null.
items.translation: 创建一个新的ReactiveInsertOperation.ReactiveInsert实例。绝不返回 null。

items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果 domainType 为 null。
